description:

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where scent projectors monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or scent vocabularies maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Scent Film Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Scent Film Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Scent Film Systems — cinema with designed scent tracks.

Phase 1 — Prove (scent projectors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scent vocabularies): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (allergy safety): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cinemas-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
